meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Store a dag definition once and re-run it in one or two lines, instead of pasting the full definition JSON into every eval cell. MUST USE whenever the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines), or asks where to put a dag definition file. Triggers: dag library, save this dag, reuse a dag, run the saved dag, stored dag definition, recurring dag, nightly dag, dag 정의 저장, 저장된 dag 실행, dag 반복 실행, DAG 만들어두고 여러 번.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 存储常用流程定义,一两行即可重复运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复运行同一套流程,不想每次重新定义
copy.tagline_en: Save a workflow definition once and rerun it in a line or two
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often rerun the same multistep pipeline without redefining it

howto.what: Claude会把DAG定义存入库文件，以后只需一两行代码就能重新运行已保存的图，无需重复粘贴定义。每次运行默认自动追加UTC时间戳键，避免覆盖旧结果；也支持指定后缀或完全复用。
howto.when: 当你想保存DAG以便复用、运行已保存的DAG、或反复调度同一张图（如夜间/每周审计）等时触发。

say.note: 写入库文件并运行一次确认
以新时间戳键启动一次新运行

say.text: 用后缀20260818重新运行nightly-audit，复用上次结果
say.note: 同后缀复用同一逻辑运行，便于幂等恢复

howto.what_en: Claude stores a DAG definition as a named JSON file in the library and later reruns it with one or two lines instead of pasting the full definition. By default each run appends a UTC timestamp to the key, so reruns never clobber old results; a custom suffix or full reuse is also supported.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, or schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines).

say_en.note: Writes the library file and runs it once to confirm.
Starts a fresh run with a new timestamp key.

say_en.text: Run nightly-audit with suffix 20260818 to reuse last result
say_en.note: Same suffix reuses the same logical run.
